cc:Work.dc:description: Four changes with the same prescribed downforce and tyre law. Peak lateral acceleration upper bound and minimum normal load at each design's OWN peak are shown; they are not compared at one common acceleration. 500 N is an illustrative filter, not a safety standard. No implementation cost, slip compatibility or vehicle measurement is claimed.
